messages:
michelle_pm: Short thread to lock acceptance for a tiny Optimize Advisor pilot. Goal: recommend per-route batching/cache/quant (int8 only) + eval-triggered alerts + manual one-click apply. Minimal launch gates?

rahul_eng: Runtime constraints: chat route max_wait_ms 10-20ms, batch route 120-200ms. Adaptive microbatch on/off flag per-route. Keep batch cap small for chat (<=8).

sara_ml: Eval safety: each recommendation runs a quick offline eval on the customer corpus. Block apply if estimated relative drop > 1.5%. Post-apply, fire alert if live relative drop >2% and abs >0.005. On alert sample 100% for 30m.

alex_cs: ACME wants audit log + revert and per-route opt-out API. They will provide corpora for both routes and accept int8 for pilot.

tim_sre: Ops: per-customer feature flag, canary rollout (5/25/100), global kill switch, and circuit-breaker to disable batching if error-rate or p99 degrades >10%. Expose batch_size_hist, cache_hit_rate, p99 in Console.

jenna_product: Proposed launch checklist: 1) 72h staging soak with p99 target met; 2) offline eval <30m; 3) synthetic regression triggers alert; 4) canary + revert tested; 5) docs + SDK example. Two-sprint pilot.

rahul_eng: Proto config snippet: ```yaml
routes:
  chat: {adaptive: true, max_wait_ms: 15, max_batch: 8}
  summarization: {adaptive: true, max_wait_ms: 150, max_batch: 64}
optimize: {recommend_quant: int8, eval_alerts: {rel: 0.02, abs: 0.005}}
```

sara_ml: Note: PII must be obfuscated before any sampling storage. Add obfuscation step in pipeline.

ci-bot: Deploy queued: feature/opt-mini -> staging (#8444)

michelle_pm: Actions: rahul perf table by route; sara eval hooks + thresholds; tim canary & kill-switch; jenna PRD + docs; alex collect corpora. Reply here when done and Ill close thread. Thanks!
